prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: wrist fracture. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1091; do not mention it.)
text:
We are writing on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], regarding the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our investigation shows that your insured crossed the centerline and struck our client's vehicle head-on while our client was traveling lawfully within their lane. Although the impact occurred at a low rate of speed, the force was sufficient to cause our client a fracture of the wrist, which required immediate medical evaluation, reduction, immobilization in a cast, and ongoing orthopedic follow-up. Our client has been unable to perform regular work duties and daily tasks that require full use of the dominant hand during recovery, and further treatment may be necessary.

Liability in this matter is clear. The police report and the physical evidence both support that your insured's vehicle left its lane. We have documented all medical expenses, lost income, and the impact of these injuries on our client's daily life.

We therefore demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this collision. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are authorized to file suit without further notice to your company. We look forward to your prompt reply.
